relationships.evidence_quote: both CIE exposure and CIE exposure + WD downregulated OPRD1 mRNA expression in SW620 cells

relationships.subject: chronic intermittent ethanol exposure

key_findings: Chronic ethanol raised global m6A but caused hypomethylation near stop codons of OPRM1 and OPRD1 in SH-SY5Y and SW620 cells.
Opioid receptor mRNA expression changes paralleled mRNA methylation changes.
